rulings.reading_a: Ivor to Tamsin and Kellan to Leonie, both parent_of; no other edge.

rulings.exact_passages_considered: The birth and will passages and the two keyed message/register sets transcribed in edges establish these readings.
rulings.disposition: Agreement upheld. No scored endpoint or predicate disagreement.
rulings.reason: The ontology permits a locally resolved name and an explicit cross-record identity link. It does not require treating a person's statement about her father as independently verified paternity.

rulings.issue: Wording and proof of the Ivor-to-Tamsin edge
rulings.reading_a: Use the two staff accounts of the birth entry and will. In n4j8 use the opening-enquiry and death-entry sentences to identify the endpoints.
rulings.reading_b: Use the same underlying records, with the estate heading and the opening-enquiry fragment as the name anchors in n4j8.
rulings.exact_passages_considered: See alternatives 1–4 of the first edge for A and alternatives 1, 2, 5 and 6 for B. The heading and the fragments in B are contiguous substrings of the Source body; they need not be whole sentences.
rulings.disposition: Both quotation selections approved; no extra independent ground awarded for a different name anchor.
rulings.reason: The heading identifies the estate, not a father by itself. It works in conjunction with the note's account of the birth entry or the testator's daughter clause. Likewise the death-entry sentence in A identifies Ivor but does not prove kinship. Both readings correctly distinguish the executor nomination from the words that prove parentage.

register.competition_and_reason: The entry agrees on the person, address and death date. The will uses the same address; it is not the source for the death date.

register.origin_reporter_and_timing: Darnmere birth entry 284 for 1969 and Ivor's signed will dated 7 October 2021, both sighted at the 26 March intake and reported by Orla and Seth by cut-off.
register.competition_and_reason: Two underlying records support the relationship. Tamsin's earlier enquiry describes the office and gift without claiming kinship; omission is not contradiction.

register.proposition: Under the sighted will, Tamsin is nominated executor and receives the residue outright.

register.competition_and_reason: The accounts agree. This is the disposition in that instrument, not proof of distribution, entitlement to every gross asset, a grant, or a beneficial interest in a trust.
